profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: ***Open ONLY TO PERMANENT/DIRECT HIRE, 100% REMOTE roles as a senior, principal, or lead software engineer.*** I am a broadly educated, emotionally literate, late career professional, with three-plus decades of experience in desktop and web-based software spanning domains from biotech to hardware to finance, developing both with Linux and Windows-based tech stacks. I've also been active for many years in charitable causes targeting children and underserved groups.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Expanded event-driven architecture using Kafka within a Spring-based Java monolith, integrating with AWS Secrets Manager and Terraform.
•	Maintained and modernized .NET/EF/SQL Server desktop applications and services, utilizing MSMQ and RabbitMQ.
•	Led analysis and partial migration of legacy .NET system to Java/Spring architecture.
•	Co-led DEI Council Culture Pillar initiatives, helping to set OKRs and presenting material onsite and virtually.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Code Review · C# · Java · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•	Sporadically consulted in-between W-2 jobs between 2016 and 2020.
•	Maintained and updated a VB.NET website for a public utility, ensuring continued functionality for users.
•	Administered AWS infrastructure underpinning a day trading application, enabling seamless operation.
•	Built a React/WordPress Plugin solution to expose normalized relational data as REST endpoints, supporting an orchid horticulture application.
positions.insights: Skills: React · PHP · JavaScript · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · Amazon EC2

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Replaced a MySQL/cron-based queue with a scalable AWS SQS/ElasticBeanstalk solution, boosting throughput from 700 orders/hour to 40,000/minute.
•	Abstracted order processing architecture, enabling the conversion of legacy batch import systems and achieving comparable performance gains.
•	Streamlined partner integrations by moving systems onto a scalable, in-house, RabbitMQ-based transformation engine.
•	Ensured GDPR and FCRA compliance through technical leadership, refactoring, and documentation of systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Code Review · PHP · Amazon SQS · AWS Elastic Beanstalk · TypeScript

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Helped design/code failover-enabled, client/server system using .NET, SQL Server, Web Services (REST, SOAP), and related Microsoft technologies.
•	Exposed legacy functionality to modern clients (web and mobile) via RESTful webservices (Json, SOAP), integrating with JavaScript and C# clients.
•	Maintained warehouse management and catch-weighting applications written in C/C++, including porting from Telnet interfaces to a modern SOA.
•	Built and/or maintained integrations to GreatPlains Dynamics, AX, Adage, QAD, and Parity ERP systems.
•	Built and maintained interfaces to Google and other public APIs.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Code Review · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · ERP Software

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Retrofit desktop application with a COM automation server and converted associated math routines to managed .NET C++ assemblies.
•	Designed and implemented a multithreaded device driver in C++, strictly adhering to a proscribed RS/232-based protocol and exporting a COM interface. Built a simulation suite to enable interactive device testing.
•	Developed a VB application to drive a National Instruments (NI) I/O card and graphically display collected data in near-real time, supporting in-house component testing.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C# · Device Drivers · COM · Mathematical Modeling

positions.title: Software Development Manager/Chief Architect
positions.description:
•	Designed and spearheaded the implementation of an n-tier, localized, globalized, B2B eProcurement application. Stack included SQL Server, COM, VB, C++, JavaScript (Ajax), MTS, and ASP.
•	Oversaw a team of up to 12 developers and testers under market pressures.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · JavaScript · Visual Basic · AJAX · T-SQL

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
•	Reimplemented a DOS-based socket server in C++ on Win32 that served vector label images from a SQL Server database to be printed and affixed to physical media used to distribute Microsoft software.
•	Created a manufacturing metrics reporting server that queried VMS and SQL Server databases and produced and emailed Excel workbooks with pivots and charts.
•	Added a custom C++/MFC DLL to a course registration system for Microsoft Technical Education (MSTE) written in Visual FoxPro, enabling the system to email fillable course registration forms to registrants using MAPI.
•	Maintained and extended usability testing software written in C++/MFC and a usability participant tracking database written in AccessBasic.
•	Lead an effort to replace the Access-based usability tracking database with a SQL Server-backed, Windows desktop application written in C++.
•	Built an extension DLL using C++/MFC for Microsoft Word that displayed a custom save dialog, allowing users to push document metadata into a SQL database.
•	Produced dynamic, web-based reports.
•	Coded a word circle game as a Java applet for inclusion in an article on the corporate intranet.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Specs · C++ · T-SQL · Microsoft Excel · Visual Basic

positions.title: Help Desk Lead/Consultant
positions.description:
•	Maintained and updated a VB.NET website for a public utility, ensuring continued functionality for users.
•	Administered AWS infrastructure underpinning a day trading application, enabling seamless operation.
•	Built a React/WordPress Plugin solution to expose normalized relational data as REST endpoints, supporting an orchid horticulture application.
positions.insights: Skills: Access VBA · C · Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

positions.title: Instructional Technician
positions.description: •	Extended AutoMenu-based DOS shell in campus computer labs with C programs and batch files that both enforced licensing restrictions on CAD and CAM software and performed scheduled maintenance on file systems.
positions.insights: Skills: C · Batch Scripting · Computer Hardware Troubleshooting · Hardware Diagnostics

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: •	Designed, developed, documented, debugged, and supported a printer driver and a specialized database application written in compiled Basic.

educations.schoolName: Johns Hopkins University Advanced Academic Programs

volunteerExperiences.description:
 Built a Java/regex-based protein search tool that is used to help discover actionable targets in pediatric
glioblastoma.
 Created backend Java routines for swapping out standard codons for custom ones complete with
relevant translation graph validation, facilitating humanization of prospective biologics.
 Augmented drug response analyzer tool (written in R), with Swing-based UI, statistical
validation/visualization of input data, and visualization of tool output.

 Formulate lesson plans and teach martial arts to adults and children from underserved groups.
 From 2015 to 2016, performed all accounting functions for the nonprofit using QuickBooks.
 Automated student intake pipeline using WordPress, Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, and Zapier.
 Prototyped a martial arts information system with Java, MySQL, and Glassfish.
 Wrote an attendance tracking application using Microsoft MVC, C#, and ASP.NET.

projects.title: Model Explores Feasibility of Tracking HIV with IR Spectroscopy
projects.description:
 Explored the feasibility of using infrared spectroscopy to track HIV-related analytes in vivo with the
hope of reducing the costs of HIV testing, optimizing the distribution of pharmaceuticals, and with an
eye on the potential for biofeedback applications.
 Presented at the University of Washington Undergraduate Research Symposium.

projects.title: Numerical Solutions to Intractable Problems
projects.description:
 Used heuristics, regression techniques, and statistical modeling in C in an attempt to detect
mechanical bias in ping-pong ball style lotto machines.
